title: Report command parsing
responsibility: Parses report command options and reads required values or JSON input.

inputs.name: reportCli.argv
inputs.description: Arguments beginning with the operation, followed by flags and positionals.

inputs.name: inputData.flags
inputs.description: Parsed flags; a truthy file takes precedence over inline data.

inputs.name: required.flags
inputs.description: Flags to inspect for a required string.

inputs.name: required.name
inputs.description: Required flag name without leading dashes.

outputs.name: reportCli
outputs.description: Operation or empty string, parsed flags and remaining positionals. Uses permissive argument parsing with declared string and boolean options.

outputs.name: inputData
outputs.description: Promise resolving to parsed file or inline JSON. The result is cast as an object without checking its shape.

outputs.name: required
outputs.description: Original nonblank string value, retaining its surrounding whitespace.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when JSON input is absent or a required option is missing/non-string/blank. Argument-parser, file-read and JSON errors also propagate.
